reviews.title: Terrible won’t load
reviews.text: This app is trash the only weather forecast it gives is a loading screen very useful guys in fact looking at a white interior wall is more accurate than this app.

reviews.title: My favorite app is not working very well and it needs fixing!
reviews.text: I love the weather channel because it’s my childhood when I was 9 years old. But the problem is that it keeps saying “oops! We have encountered a problem” or something’. It does not show how hot or cold it is, doesn’t show the icon, all of it doesn’t work at all. Although It feels like the planet Hoth outside because it’s winter time. So I have to use my weather widget. Will you Please fix the problem for me because I have the same problem every time I open the app. Although I’m watching Star Wars Empire Strikes Back right now, so I’ll go to sleep after the movie is over.
